title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A counter nobody read any more
summary: Yesterday's fix replaced a counter of events with a plain question. The counter was left behind: still written on every deletion, read by nobody.

highlights.title: No behaviour change
highlights.description: A map grew by one entry per deleted file for the whole session and fed no decision. The test that forbade walking it guarded nothing.

sections.heading: Internal
bullets: The guard now watches the set that replaced the map, the only one left that can grow with the session.
The marks telling two overlapping scans apart are released on both exits rather than only on success.
